description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.

> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).

title.en: Query the List of LoRaWAN Credentials

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明


单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 50.

 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
